_doc: The player's body walked into the solid scatter from the real keys (world/scatter_solids.gd), on the batch-4 world round Merrowby: an oak, a boulder seated leaning 19 degrees, a field hedge and a drystone wall, each approached square on, W held until the body has stopped against it, and filmed from its right side and over its shoulder. Run with --fixed-fps 60: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x900x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver opengl3 --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1600x900 --fixed-fps 60 -- --capture=tools/capture/plans/scatter_stops.json --out=<dir>
